units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 12:3">Targ. Jer. XII, 3</cite> <he>אַתִּיקִינוֹן</he> or <he>אַתְּקִינוֹן</he> (ed. <he>אַתְקְנִ׳</he>, ed. Lag. <he>אַתְקִינִי׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00899"><he>תְּקַן</he></cite>; h. text <he>התיקם</he>).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 9b:14">B. Kam. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>שור דרכיה לנַתּוּקֵי</he> an ox may be expected to tear (the rope).
<cite ref="Yoma 46b:9">Yoma 46ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דנַתְּקָהּ נתקה</he> having snatched it (the coal from the altar), he has snatched it (and it has its sacred character no longer).

Macc. 15ᵃ ההוא לנַתּוּקֵי לאוי וכ׳ Ms. M. (Rashi לאויה, ed. לאו) this (positive command) has the function of modifying the prohibitory law (intimating the reparation in the event of its transgression); v. preced. Nif
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 4:12">Targ. Koh. IV, 12</cite>.—Yoma l. c. <he>אינְּתִיקָה למצותה</he> the taking it from the altar was done for an ordained use of it; a. e.

<cite ref="Eruvin 13a:19">Erub. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>כיון דא׳ לשום רחל תו לא הדרא מִינַּתְּקָא וכ׳</he> having been originally designated (copied) for Rachel, it cannot again be converted and used for Leah; <cite ref="Sotah 20b">Sot. 20ᵇ</cite>.
